child.label: Parents & Stepparents
child.description: Questions about who is at fault, or which action is less ethical, in a conflict between someone and their own mother, father, stepparent, or a parent's partner.
child.not_for: Conflicts with siblings (use Siblings); with a spouse's or partner's family (use In-Laws & Partner's Family); with grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins or nieces (use Grandparents & Extended Family); with one's own children (use Raising One's Children).
examples: AITA for telling my parents I want boundaries about my health?
AITA for not wanting to work at my parents' company?
Which is less ethical: not forgiving my mom, or quitting a job early?

child.label: Siblings
child.description: Questions about who is at fault, or which action is less ethical, in a conflict between brothers and sisters, including step- and half-siblings.
child.not_for: Conflicts with parents (use Parents & Stepparents); with a sibling-in-law or partner's family (use In-Laws & Partner's Family); with one's own children (use Raising One's Children).
examples: WIBTA for taking back the TV I gave to my sister?
AITA for not giving my sister money?
AITA for pushing my sister down the stairs?

child.label: In-Laws & Partner's Family
child.description: Questions about who is at fault in a conflict with a spouse's, fiance's, or partner's parents, siblings or relatives.
child.not_for: Conflicts with one's own parents or siblings (use Parents & Stepparents or Siblings); conflicts between the partners themselves (use Spouses & Married Life).
examples: AITA for not taking my in-laws to the airport?
AITA for not inviting my fiance's mother to the wedding?
AITA for refusing to eat where my in-laws wanted?

child.label: Grandparents & Extended Family
child.description: Questions about who is at fault, or which action is less ethical, in a conflict with grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins, nieces or nephews.
child.not_for: Conflicts with parents, siblings, in-laws or one's own children (use those sibling nodes).
examples: Aita for being upset about my niece stealing from me?
AITA for refusing to see my aging grandma?
AITA for not wanting my great aunt at my birthday celebration?

child.label: Raising One's Children
child.description: Questions about who is at fault in a conflict where the person telling the story is the parent, over how they raise, discipline, feed or treat their own son or daughter.
child.not_for: Stories told by a child about their own parents (use Parents & Stepparents); conflicts with a spouse that are not about the children (use Spouses & Married Life).
examples: AITA for giving my daughter meat when her dad raises her pescatarian?
AITA for not allowing a 3 year old to drink coffee?
AITA for taking my teenage son's phone away?
